create_vmas_env: create a VmasEnv lambda via VmasClass.get_env_fun with num_envs, continuous_actions, seed, and device
check_continuous_actions: check if VmasClass supports continuous actions by calling supports_continuous_actions method
get_group_map: get the agent group mapping from a VmasEnv using VmasClass.group_map method
extract_observation_spec: extract the observation spec for a VmasEnv by calling VmasClass.observation_spec and filtering out info keys
list_vmas_tasks: list all available VMAS tasks from the VmasTask enum including BALANCE, FLOCKING, FOOTBALL, and SIMPLE_TAG
